title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
lede: Anthropic's IPO disclosures show Amazon will own 14.7% and Google 13.7% after the listing, both through non-voting shares, and Amazon is holding back notes that could push it higher.

points: Amazon's 2023 and 2024 investments were promissory notes that convert to equity at about $2.09 or $5.05 per share.
It is converting part of them into non-voting shares that pay dividends and become voting Class A stock when sold.
Converting every remaining note today would take Amazon to 23.8% of Anthropic.
AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia and TSMC Partners agreed to buy $26 billion of non-voting stock, Google and Nvidia $10 billion each.
Anthropic has separately committed to spend more than $100 billion on AWS over the next ten years.

sections.text: The two biggest cloud backers will hold close to 30% of Claude's maker without votes, and the decade-long AWS spending commitment keeps Anthropic's compute closely tied to Amazon.
